namespace PubAC11
def WeakEdgeColor (cu cv : Nat) : Prop := cu ≤ 1 ∧ cv ≤ 1
def checkEdge2Color (cu cv : Nat) : Bool := ((cu == 0) || (cu == 1)) && ((cv == 0) || (cv == 1)) && (cu != cv)
theorem monoZero_meets_weak : WeakEdgeColor 0 0 := by sorry
theorem properTwoColor_edge (cu cv : Nat) (h : checkEdge2Color cu cv = true) : (cu = 0 ∨ cu = 1) ∧ (cv = 0 ∨ cv = 1) ∧ cu ≠ cv := by sorry
theorem monoZero_rejected : checkEdge2Color 0 0 = false := by sorry
end PubAC11
